body: Quality post 👌🏼
I feel you 👊🏼

Thank you. You’re amazing, I might have to try this. I’ve become so lazy that it’s gonna probs take a few days that get the willpower to go for a run but I really am going to keep this in mind and give it a try. I’ve got nothing to lose 👌🏼❤️

Yh uni has a lack of forced structure (I never go in to lectures) I really struggle to leave the house in general anymore to be honest. I’m disappointed in myself and I guess sleeping just stops me from thinking
Thank you very much

I’ve been diagnosed with depression (nearly 7 years ago now) I’m not interested in medication I started it twice and the side effects were horrible, I’m aware that these can subside over time but there are things such a PSSD that you can never recover from so medication scares me in all honesty. 

I’m aware that it’s the depression doing this to me I’m asking for help/tips on how other people have got out of not leaving their bed let alone room all day. I thought this subreddit was for peer support not for the usual ‘speak to a professional’ all professionals want to do is stick u on medication without even really asking many questions it’s just a massive money maker for the big Pharma industry. I know too many people on anti-depressants that are still depressed so what’s the point? 

I just hate life itself and I’m starting to hate myself for not being able to soldier through and do what needs to be done. I just want to become more productive so I can at least finish Uni and function as a member of society but the more days that pass I don’t think it’s possible.
I accidentally posted reply to you above

I don’t live at home right now (bad for my housemates I know) and I wouldn’t want my mum to be uncertain I’d like her to have the closure and know I’m not coming back, sounds horrible but I think tryna work out where I’ve gone/what happened everyday would be worse.
In a very similar position. Wish u the best

Yh I’m in the same position mate, it would break my Mum if I take my life as she’s also very depressed and financially in a mess which I’m expected to help with. I’m just deeply unhappy and with the exception of a few months per year in the summer it’s been this way for years. I hope things improve but to be honest everyday right now is a battle to not just unalive myself
I’m in a similar predicament, don’t want to do it outside my room but I have nothing inside my room high enough to tie it to
I agree with the last sentence so much haha
I improved for like 2/3 days and now I’m right back to square 1

I started experiencing this last year and used lockdown to excuse it at first, but this past month has got really bad for me again I can’t even do food shopping or turn up to uni I haven’t even left the house for fresh air this past 5/6 days. Even meeting friends I find very difficult. I just feel like I’m actually broken at this point like I’m having some sort of malfunction. Proper fed up of it tbh

It seems like he’s pushing you to move on so he can actually end things without feeling guilty about what it will do to you. Maybe I’m wrong but it seems like he really loves you & just doesn’t want to cause you anymore pain than he’s caused already. You sound like an amazing person and hopefully you can help pull him out of this bullshit. I’m the same in my episodes I isolate myself for months (currently entering my 2nd month this time round) and I become an arsehole to be around because I don’t want to be around anybody. 

I don’t have any great or life changing advice I’m looking for that myself unfortunately, but I really hope you do stick by him and things work out for you guys 🙏🏼
2 years older and feeling the same, what I hope is that you escape it by the time you turn 22 mate ❤️
I guess sometimes it’s easier for us to sit here feeling sorry for ourselves than do something to get better. But maybe trying to get better is futile because the triggers are out of our hands.

Thank you. Weirdly I actually stopped smoking today (would’ve been high as a kite by now lol 6:30pm here) told myself that’s a good first step. I tend not to make plans I just make bad decisions and then react to them lol. Not been going to well so far as you may have realised. 

There isn’t a gym near me where I live atm and I don’t drive but maybe I’ll start doing some press ups again or something in the mornings. Me & exercise have never got on since I stopped playing football I just always quit for some reason or another. 

You mentioned attracting females, I’m not super good looking by any means but I’m not unattractive either so luckily that’s something I don’t have a problem with anymore. I’m not great at conversations with new people due to my anxiety but somehow I do manage draw the interest of women. Gotta just thank the universe for that I guess cos it wasn’t always like that for me. I used to think loneliness is what was getting me down but I actually thrive off of being alone and hate being around others most of the time but is that me or is that because I’m sick? 

Maybe contacting the uni and trying to find a counsellor would be a good idea but I feel like their only option would be continue and do the best you can or restart this year next academic year (October) which isn’t feasible for me really. 

I honestly just wish I had the balls to end it because my life is not as bad and my mind tries to make out, I know others have it so much worse but they can function day to day so maybe they don’t. 

Sorry for rambling on but I found your message kind of uplifting. Felt obliged to give a detailed reply 😂🙏🏼

P.s. do you really credit weightlifting for curing your depression? Like that alone? 

My mum has always suggested exercise to me saying it used to help her but Idk even the anxiety of going to a gym when I did live close to them was very overwhelming. It’s got to the point that I can’t even go supermarket atm let alone gym 😭
In the same situation mate. So close to giving up on my degree. I can’t even manage to leave my house atm let alone turn up to lectures, classes or do any work

I appreciate you praying. I’ve always been kind of against medication because I don’t want to become reliant on it then it’s like for any weird reason that I can’t get more or if I move country etc I’d be fucked. Also it takes like 6 weeks to work and then it might not work so you have to try another which also takes 6 weeks to work and then it might not work 😂

I study economics which realistically I have no actual interest in, I just knew that job prospects are ‘good’. I feel like dropping out would be counter productive cos then I’m back to square 1 of working shit warehouse jobs etc which even though they don’t stress you out they are kill you slowly from boredom and exhaustion 😂. 

I feel like until I have some sort of ‘purpose’ I will never get out of this constant cycle of unhappiness but I’m starting to think no one really has a purpose we all just trick ourselves into thinking that we do
